name: Krypkasino
description: Krypkasino (Swedish for 'Crawl Casino') is the popular misere (avoidance) variant of the card game Casino, widely played in Sweden. Unlike standard Casino where the goal is to capture high-point cards, in Krypkasino, players aim to avoid capturing any cards, especially those with point values. It is a game of avoidance, forced capture, and tactical hand-dumping.

content.text: Krypkasino (Swedish for 'Crawl Casino') is the popular misere (avoidance) variant of the card game Casino, widely played in Sweden. Unlike standard Casino where the goal is to capture high-point cards, in Krypkasino, players aim to avoid capturing any cards, especially those with point values. It is a game of avoidance, forced capture, and tactical hand-dumping.

Developed in Sweden in the late 19th century as a 'reverse' adaptation of the international fishing game Casino. Misere variants are a characteristic feature of Swedish card culture (e.g., Krypkille).
Standard 52-card deck. **Special Capture Values**: 10 of Diamonds = 16, 2 of Spades = 15, Aces = 14 or 1.
